interfaces.interface_notes: Coarse B2 particles formed in the γ phase have flat interfaces and sharp edges; nano-indentation yields compound hardness values of matrix + particles because the technique cannot measure isolated nano-sized precipitates.
interfaces.phase_evolution: At 500–700 °C the α (ferrite) phase in the Ni-containing sample was replaced by B2 stringer bands, while κ-carbides formed nano-sized blocks in the austenite phase; coarse B2 particles also formed in the γ matrix.
interfaces.slip_behavior: According to the Orowan mechanism, the increase in shear stress (Δτ) is proportional to the inverse of the precipitates' diameter (Δτ ∝ R^−1.25); as precipitate size decreases the resistance to shear increases.

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: The experimental alloys were melted in an induction furnace.
Materials cut into 3-mm × 3-mm × 1-mm samples prior to annealing.
Annealing treatments were conducted at 500 °C, 700 °C, 900 °C and 1050 °C; holding time not explicitly reported. This sample corresponds to the 700 °C treatment.

structures.microstructure_counts: γ austenite matrix + cuboidal κ precipitates + coarse B2 particles + B2 stringer bands (former α phase)

phases_present.morphology: coarse particles with flat interfaces and sharp edges
stringer bands (elongated bands replacing prior α phase)

microstructure_list.region: B2 stringer bands (replacing the prior α/ferrite phase)

structures.overall_structure: Austenite (γ) matrix containing cuboidal κ-carbides (<100 nm), coarse B2 particles (2–7 μm) with flat interfaces and sharp edges, and B2 stringer bands (the former α/ferrite phase replaced by stringers) after annealing at 700 °C
